text:
Maya: dropping a quick compact-ledger mock in Figma, trying to reduce vertical noise while keeping invoice actions discoverable. https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/spend-compact-ledger
Oliver: seeing it. curious about the scope control 141414 (top-left) 121212. do we keep the full org/project toggle or move to a pill?
Maya: leaning pill that shows "Scope: Org ▾" on desktop and collapses to an icon-only pill on narrow widths. preserves header real estate.
Sam: pill is sleek but worried about discoverability for non-power-users. can we add a subtle label plus a keyboard shortcut hint?
Tash: agree with Sam. proposal: visible text on desktop, icon-only on mobile. also add aria label and focus outline.
Maya: keyboard shortcut suggestion: `g s` to jump to scope. Thoughts?
Priya: `g s` OK. ensure it's listed in the Help menu and tooltip reads "Scope (g s)". accessibility: pill should have role=button and aria-expanded when menu open.
Oliver: invoice UX: current mock shows full "Download invoice" per row. could we reduce weight by using an icon-only button plus a bulk download toolbar when rows are selected?
Sam: icon-only helps density but might reduce clarity. compromise: icon-only by default, show text on hover/focus, and keep a persistent bulk toolbar when multi-select active.
Tash: microcopy: be explicit about format. use "Download invoice (PDF)" not just "Download". also include "Export CSV" when available.
Maya: agreed, will update copy. also adding a small kebab menu for per-row extras (view details, dispute, export).
Priya: keyboard & screen reader note: per-row actions must be reachable by keyboard. tooltips cannot be the only way to reveal meaning. visible focus state required.
Oliver: charts: do we inline token breakdown rows under each project or show breakdown in an overlay? overlay avoids layout shifts.
Sam: overlay + accessible expander button. expander should be a real button with aria-controls pointing to the overlay region. overlay must close with Esc.
Maya: new pattern: show total cost + mini-sparkline in ledger row. trailing chevron expands an anchored overlay with per-token lines, colored bars, and per-token cost. overlay is non-modal but gets focus.
Tash: when overlay open, trap focus inside until Esc? if non-modal, trapping is controversial. maybe set aria-modal=false but move focus to overlay on open and return on close. announce with live region.
Priya: yes, move focus on open, restore on close, role=dialog and aria-modal=false. overlay should be keyboard-navigable and closable by both Esc and a dedicated close button.
Oliver: caching concern - breakdown data will be fetched per row. Devs: can we prefetch for first N visible rows and cache for session?
Sam: prefetch top 8 rows and cache for 5 minutes. also debounce rapid opens to batch requests.
Maya: layout toggle: ledger default, but add a view menu with "Card view" for higher-level summaries. remember preference per workspace.
Tash: please add copy for empty states: "No spend recorded yet — generate activity or check older invoices" and a CTA to "View billing history".
Priya: color & contrast check for icon-only buttons. ensure WCAG AA for icons and 4.5:1 for critical actions on hover/focus.
Maya: final checklist before I push updated frames: 1) scope pill with visible label + `g s` shortcut entry, 2) icon-only download + bulk toolbar + explicit "Download invoice (PDF)" copy, 3) accessible overlay pattern for token breakdown with focus management, 4) ledger default + optional card toggle, 5) empty state copy and contrast checks. anything missing?
Sam: add tooltip text that is focusable and readable by screen readers (not hover-only).
Oliver: include a tiny inline legend with color swatches in overlays so users can map colors to token types quickly.
Priya: PDF invoice copy: use "Compute units (tokens)" header so finance sees canonical term. UI stays "tokens".
Maya: great. I'll update Figma and post version link here. thanks! :sparkles:
